summary.text: Tim Goodwin is a Republican state representative from District 30 who returned to the House in January 2025 after earlier service from 2017 to 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a businessman and U.S. Army veteran who chairs the House Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tim Goodwin served in the U.S. Army, and his career experience includes working as a businessman, according to Ballotpedia.
He represented South Dakota House District 30 from 2017 to 2023 and assumed office again on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session, Goodwin chairs the House Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee and serves on the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
